name: 政企业务网页
positioning: 适合事项管理、项目台账、审批协同和运营监管类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts

layout_rules: Use a fixed dark left navigation on wide screens and an off-canvas navigation below 820px.
Map every visible sidebar item to one complete top-level page view; display exactly one page view at a time and never use sidebar anchors to scroll between stacked pages.
Use a 64px white top bar and a light gray page canvas.
Keep page content within 1440px and use 24px desktop page padding.
Use four-column metric cards on wide screens, two columns on medium screens, and one column on narrow screens.
Place query filters above the primary table; preserve visible labels for every field.
Open record details in a right-side drawer when users need to retain list context.
Require a confirmation modal before irreversible or state-changing actions.

component_inventory.name: primary_navigation
component_inventory.use_for: top-level modules and system sections; every visible item opens one complete page view

component_inventory.name: page_view
component_inventory.use_for: mutually exclusive top-level pages inside the single HTML file

component_inventory.name: metric_card
component_inventory.use_for: two to six high-value summary indicators

component_inventory.name: business_table
component_inventory.use_for: dense records with explicit row actions

component_inventory.name: detail_drawer
component_inventory.use_for: record inspection or light editing without leaving the list

interaction_contracts: All controls must be reachable and operable by keyboard.
The mobile navigation toggle must expose aria-controls and aria-expanded.
Page navigation must synchronize aria-current, breadcrumb text, and the document title, reset the content scroll position, and preserve each page's local control state.
The detail drawer must expose role=dialog, aria-modal, an accessible title, Escape close, focus containment, and focus restoration.
The confirmation prompt should use the native dialog element when available.
Filtering must update the visible result count and show an explicit empty state.
Every state-changing action must produce visible and aria-live feedback.

preserve: dark left navigation plus light content canvas
blue as the single primary action color
compact square controls and restrained corner radii
clear borders and medium-high information density
filter plus table plus contextual detail workflow
semantic status colors and confirmation before state changes
replace_from_development_document: drawer fields, timeline, buttons, and messages
avoid: third-party logos, brand names, screenshots, or original product copy
decorative gradients in the main content area
large rounded cards or pill buttons except semantic status badges
using color alone to communicate state
placeholder controls that have no visible response

single_file_compilation.style_source: inline the complete contents of tokens.css into a style element
single_file_compilation.script_source: inline the complete contents of interactions.js before the closing body tag
single_file_compilation.asset_policy: use inline SVG or CSS shapes only; do not introduce external URLs
